name: Spinach and Mushroom Frittata
method: Slice the mushrooms, halve the tomatoes and beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a small ovenproof frying pan and soften the mushrooms for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and tomatoes and stir for 1 minute until the spinach wilts.
Heat the grill to high. Pour the eggs into the pan, scatter over the cheese and cook over a low heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the base is set.
Put the pan under the grill for 2 minutes until the top is golden and set. Slide onto a plate and serve.
